name: mistral-vibe-2api
description: Reverse proxy that keeps a Mistral Vibe API key usable inside third-party agents: forwards requests with the official Vibe CLI's fingerprint. Works as a magpie/OpenCode provider plugin or as a standalone OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible proxy.
